name: dk-annual-reporting-reference
description: Selected Danish annual-reporting source reference for an ordinary ongoing non-listed ApS or A/S under the class-B screen. Covers reporting-class and micro size tests, selected audit and accountant-assistance screens, annual report receipt deadlines, current submission formats and late-fee examples. Trigger on Danish årsrapport, Erhvervsstyrelsen, Regnskab Basis or Special, class B, micro reporting or fravalg af revision. This Tier 2 pending-review reference does not provide a complete financial-statements country method or authorise an actual exemption, financial statement, fee result or filing.
